dict.string: HeartRate Broadcaster advertises as a standard Bluetooth heart rate monitor so devices like Garmin and Wahoo can receive your heart rate. It also connects to your power meter, cadence sensor and trainer to record a workout.
HeartRate Broadcaster reads your heart rate so it can be relayed to your bike computer or fitness device.
HeartRate Broadcaster records a workout session on your Apple Watch so heart rate can be sampled continuously.
HeartRate Broadcaster offers this phone to cycling apps on your network as a virtual shifter, so you can change gear from the app.
